types.label: Burglary in progress
narratives: RP reports a subject breaking into the residence at {address}.
{caller} reports hearing glass break and seeing someone inside {address}.

types.label: Prowler
narratives: RP reports a prowler in the yard of {address}.
Caller advises a subject looking into windows and trying door handles near {near}.

types.label: Vehicle break-in in progress
narratives: RP reports a subject breaking into parked cars on {street}.
Caller advises someone smashing a car window near {cross}, subject still on scene.

types.label: Theft in progress
narratives: RP reports a subject taking items from {address} right now.
Caller reports a person loading {item} into a vehicle near {near}.

types.label: Commercial burglary in progress
narratives: Alarm company reports a break-in at the business at {address}, subject seen inside.
RP reports a subject forcing a rear door of the building at {address}.

types.label: Peeping subject
narratives: RP reports a subject looking into a bedroom window at {address}.
Resident at {address} reports a person watching through the window and running when seen.
